name: The Conscience
overview: Scripture reveals the conscience as an inner witness that bears testimony before God and men, guiding moral awareness even among those without the written law, as seen in Romans 2:14-15. The apostle Paul exemplifies a clear conscience maintained through faithful living, striving to remain without offense toward God and others (Acts 23:1; 24:16). However, the conscience can be defiled by unbelief and impurity, affecting one’s perception of holiness (Titus 1:15). Ultimately, the conscience operates in harmony with the Spirit, affirming truth and righteousness in the believer’s life (Romans 9:1).
